admission_assessment.wddm_reasoning: GPU-resident parts (1.38 GiB dense arena, natively served attention/embedding tensors, 32K int8 KV, and an auto expert cache sized to free VRAM minus 3072 MiB) charge commit about 1:1, so several GiB of GPU use is also several GiB of commit; the 18 Oct 0.1.45 nodraft load charged 9.1 GiB commit in its first 7 s. The 31.6 GiB of mapped experts are file-backed (no commit) but need physical RAM when touched; the 4 GiB cap only turns overrun into soft faults.
admission_assessment.verdict: strata-q2-mmap32 then the 600 s greeting cannot pass admission with apps open: VRAM 5.8-6.9 GiB is below 7000 MiB, commit 8.5-11.7 GiB is below 14 GiB, and available RAM 6-11 GiB is below 12 GiB. Even on physical need alone, about 9-10 GiB of commit plus the 1 GiB floor leaves no margin at the low end of the range. It needs the apps-closed window (at least Edge/Gradle/emulator closed, with GPU-heavy apps closed for VRAM), and it is blocked anyway until the template check and the WDDM reserve decision are done.
